summary: Integrated the verified GitHub-URL-clone task with the latest default branch (4d7244e, which layers detached-sibling-window spawn + orchestration recovery and harness error logging, commits 9894234/843bbf3, onto story-2's browse task) and re-verified the integrated result end to end. Integration-verification failure diagnosed from the integrator's own verification record: the inherited full-suite check asserted the pre-integration frozen count 'test result: ok. 446 passed', while the integrated tree's lib suite carries 449 tests (master's 9894234 recovery work adds three), so the grep -q died under set -eu with the observed empty-output /bin/sh failure (the focused-filter command in front of it had passed 43/43 in the same run). Latent secondary mismatches in the replayed checks were repaired alongside it, without weakening any gate: /tmp/clippy.sw3.before had been captured at the pre-move base 1620f50 ('useless use of format!' counted 3x) versus 2x at pristine 4d7244e, so the D-34 baseline was re-established on 4d7244e by cold-clipping a pristine git-archive extraction (/tmp/sw3base) and installed at /tmp/clippy.sw3.before (copy at /tmp/clippy.sw3.base4d72); and the diff-scope check's expectation no longer held because the patch had been applied fully staged, so the canonical topology was restored (three src diffs unstaged, Packet-managed report/adr files left as staged) and the check now asserts scope in BOTH the unstaged and HEAD-relative views. Both sides of the merge confirmed present and coherent (master's queue-recovery machinery and this task's CloneJob wiring occupy disjoint areas; master's new e2e recovery asserts run green in the same suite). All gates re-executed in this integration worktree: focused filter 43/43 (parser matrix, clone trio, perform_clone family, eight sw_ tick/card tests); full offline suite green (lib 449 + multi_repository_feature + task_workflow); D-34 clippy delta EMPTY against the integrated base with no warning naming any new symbol (parse_github_url, perform_clone, clone_repo, CloneJob, conn_github, GithubTarget, tracked_in_head); perform_clone family 7/7; scope exactly the three sanctioned source files with zero Cargo manifest delta; binary builds and boots 10s clean on the live display with zero panics. Feature delivered per ticket: a pasted https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}(.git) URL is std-only parsed with per-quirk distinct operator-actionable messaging, cloned off-thread with the system git CLI (vector args, no shell) into $HOME/{repo} behind scratch {repo}.packet-cloning.{pid} plus stale-scratch sweep plus atomic rename, then driven through the UNMODIFIED submit_connect -> attempt_connect authority (validation, transaction recovery, state load, planning-scaffold bootstrap, legacy migrate, chat hydration, queue load) finishing on Connected with the standard toast; invalid URLs spawn no thread/subprocess, failed clones and pre-existing non-working-tree destinations keep the operator on the initial screen with specific banners, and conn_github is cleared only on success.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given the initial screen after story 2 with both fields empty, When I type 'https://github.com/octocat/Hello-World' in the GitHub row and press 'Clone', Then the card immediately shows a dim 'Cloning Hello-World from GitHub…' status line, the Open/Browse…/Clone buttons are disabled and Enter/Open clicks are inert, and when the worker finishes the path field equals $HOME/Hello-World, the URL field is empty, conn_error is None, and the app is on the Connected screen with the 'Connected to Hello-World' toast.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Post-integration, green in the worktree under verification. Status line 'Cloning {repo} from GitHub…' painting plus the busy card swallowing every input signal (Open/Browse…/Clone clicks inert via disabled button_shell + forced-low flags, Enter returning false) is locked by app::root::tests::sw_clone_card_freezes_in_flight_and_scopes_enter_per_focus (asserts the in-flight status RichText paints and flags are force-cleaned). Parse of the exact octocat URL (plain/.git) is covered by app::welcome::tests::parse_github_url_accepts_canonical_forms. Worker-settle success flow (screen swapped to Screen::Connected with the project title, conn_path == dest, conn_github emptied, conn_error None) is locked by app::root::tests::sw_clone_ticket_two_success_flows_into_submit_connect_and_connected, which runs the REAL submit_connect against a real mkrepo-style temp tree and additionally asserts the planning index landed in the clone. The offline analog of the real GitHub fetch (perform_clone of a local source into a sandboxed $HOME, then the SAME attempt_connect) is app::welcome::tests::perform_clone_local_source_feeds_the_full_connect_pipeline. The public-octocat network leg of the manual smoke is the operator-workstation cargo run step the ticket itself labels network-dependent (test-plan item 6); the app booted 10s clean on the live display with zero panics (launch smoke re-run post-integration).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given the initial screen, When I submit any of 'http://github.com/o/r', 'https://gitee.com/o/r', 'https://github.com/o/r/branch', 'git@github.com:o/r.git', 'https://github.com:443/o/r', 'https://user:token@github.com/o/r', 'https://github.com/o/r?ref=1', or the empty string, Then conn_error contains the specific grammatical complaint with the canonical shape, clone_job is None (no thread ever spawned), no connect is attempted, and the screen stays the initial screen.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Every enumerated paste is asserted verbatim in the 24-case parser matrix app::welcome::tests::parse_github_url_rejects_each_quirk_with_distinct_actionable_guidance (http://, ftp://, ssh://, gitee.com, githubcorp.com, scp git@github.com:o/r.git, :443 port, user:token@ userinfo, ?ref=1 query, #anchor fragment, '/', '..', leading/trailing '-', charset violation, single-part and three-part paths, bare domain), each refusal a DISTINCT operator-actionable sentence naming the canonical shape 'https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}'. UI-level no-thread proofs: sw_begin_clone_blank_is_noop_and_unparsable_urls_spawn_nothing (blank -> silent no-op with clone_job None; 'notaurl' -> 'Can't clone that URL' banner, clone_job None, field untouched, no connect attempted) and sw_clone_ticket_five_unparseable_past_surfaces_readable_banner_and_spawns_nothing (gitee-style paste -> banner, clone_job None, screen Welcome). Empty-string subclause: the Clone control is disabled on an empty trimmed URL (asserted by the disabled-click in sw_clone_card_freezes_in_flight_and_scopes_enter_per_focus) and begin_clone double-guards as a silent no-op (asserted); calling parse_github_url('') directly still yields the canonical-shape complaint. Parsing precedes any thread/subprocess, so quirk-bearing strings never reach git. All green post-integration.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a syntactically valid URL whose clone fails (e.g. a nonexistent/private repo, network refused), When the worker exits nonzero, Then conn_error shows the 'git clone … failed' headline with git's trimmed stderr tail, the screen is still the initial screen, the pasted URL remains in the GitHub field for correction, and pressing Clone again starts a fresh worker with a stale-scratch sweep first.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Locked by sw_clone_ticket_three_failed_clone_raises_git_banner_and_preserves_field: a worker returning AppError::Git{'clone {source}', trimmed git stderr} surfaces conn_error = '<headline>\n<stderr tail>' via the SHARED conn_banner helper (extracted so submit_connect and the clone-completion path cannot drift); Screen::Welcome retained; conn_github byte-preserved for correction; and a SECOND clone-dispatch round asserts the fresh-worker retry. The stale-scratch sweep preceding any re-clone is asserted in app::welcome::tests::perform_clone_sweeps_stale_scratch_before_cloning (foreign-pid '<repo>.packet-cloning.999' AND same-pid seeds removed before git runs, no remnants after). Real nonzero git exit -> AppError::Git with non-blank detail is proven offline by core::gitops::tests::clone_repo_missing_source_errors_git. Panicked-worker variant (join Err) covered by sw_clone_ticket_four_panicked_worker_reports_stopped_unexpectedly. Green post-integration.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given $HOME already contains a NON-git directory named {repo}, When I clone that URL, Then no clone runs (destination pre-exists), the app runs attempt_connect on it, and the legacy banner 'no .git directory found — Packet plans inside a git working tree...' appears verbatim — the pre-existing directory is diagnosed by the incumbent path, not invented new logic.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Locked by app::welcome::tests::perform_clone_preexisting_directory_fast_paths_and_connect_diagnoses_it: perform_clone on a planted NON-git $HOME/{repo} returns Ok(dest) IMMEDIATELY (marker file byte-identical, zero '*packet-cloning*' entries created, no re-clone), then the SAME unmodified attempt_connect raises the incumbent legacy InvalidRepo banner whose detail contains 'no .git directory found' verbatim from the story-2 path (unchanged; sw_browse_choice_on_plain_folder_then_open_shows_legacy_invalid_repo_banner is the browse-side control, still green). Diagnosed entirely by the incumbent path — no invented new logic. Green post-integration.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a fresh clone of a repository that contains no planning/ artifacts, When connect completes, Then planning/specification.md plus the open-items and config artifacts exist in the destination (bootstrap_missing ran), the chat store under (PACKET_HOME or) ~/.packet/projects/<slug>/chat.jsonl holds the welcome message, and the Loaded project's queue and git snapshot populated — identical side-effects to typing the same path, because it literally is the same attempt_connect call.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Locked by app::welcome::tests::perform_clone_local_source_feeds_the_full_connect_pipeline: a planning-less local source is cloned into a sandboxed $HOME and connected THROUGH THE UNMODIFIED attempt_connect -> Ok(Project) titled 'sw-clone'; bootstrap_missing ran (planning/specification.md planted, then D-28 migrate() converted it to the product index + archived legacy spec — both asserted, plus open-items and config files asserted present); the welcome chat line is appended to chat.jsonl under the PACKET_HOME-redirected store keyed by slug; project.git branch='main'/dirty=0/subject contains 'migrate' and the queue loaded (auto_mode true). Byte-parity with a hand-typed path is reinforced by perform_clone_plain_repo_connects_identically_to_a_typed_path (same tree connected via clone vs via typed path produces identical scaffold/migrate/hydrate side-effects); the tick-level tests prove the only route into Connected after a clone is submit_connect. Green post-integration.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given $HOME/{repo} already exists as a healthy working tree from a previous clone, When I clone the same URL again, Then the worker returns the destination immediately (no re-clone, no '*packet-cloning*' remnants), the field refills, and the app reconnects.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Locked by app::welcome::tests::perform_clone_healthy_existing_tree_fast_paths_without_retouching: healthy existing tree -> immediate Ok(dest), planted note byte-identical, HEAD subject unchanged (provably NO re-clone, not even a new commit), zero scratch remnants; the field-refill + reconnect halves are the Ok(Ok) drain arm of tick exercised in sw_clone_ticket_two_success_flows_into_submit_connect_and_connected (conn_path == dest, conn_github cleared, conn_error None, screen Connected against the surviving tree). Green post-integration.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a clone in flight, When I press Enter in the path field, click Open, or click Browse…, Then nothing happens (buttons disabled, Enter scoped) — and conversely, with neither field focused, Enter is inert, with the path field focused Enter connects, with the URL field focused Enter starts the clone.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Locked by sw_clone_card_freezes_in_flight_and_scopes_enter_per_focus: in-flight frames return false unconditionally with hostile sticky browse/clone flags force-cleaned (Enter / Open click / Browse… all inert while cloning). Conversely, focus-scoped Enter: NEITHER field focused -> Enter inert (retired global hook; the disclosed intentional narrowing documented in paint's doc comment); PATH field focused -> Enter submits only when non-empty (incumbent empty-guard honored); URL field focused -> *clone_requested=true and no submit. Click-to-focus + Tab navigation and the Open button's mouse path are preserved (story-2-era card tests still green at the new arity). Green post-integration.
